# Operators see where a release stands without reading the records

A status page shows the release operator the percent complete, the blockers and the decisions owed, from the records on the line, with the time each fact was read. It serves the release operator between sessions, deciding what to merge, approve or unblock. It matters now because the 4.0.0 release has 246 tasks across three epics and the operator reads about a dozen records a day to find the blockers; the page replaces that reading before the release closes.

Epic EPC-204, in progress.

## Progress

79 of 246 tasks complete, read at 13:41 EST, 2 Nov.

## Blockers

- The quality defaults line waits for its reviewer.
- The hook binary on the build host differs from the line.
